Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Timefalls
Cardtype: Action / Reaction / Combat
Discipline: Thaumaturgy / Temporis
[tha] [COMBAT] Press.
[tem] [REACTION] Only usable at the end of an action, if at least 4 actions have been taken during this minion phase. Minions can't take actions this turn.
[TEM] [ACTION] +1 stealth action. Play a master card that can be put into play from your hand. Pay cost as normal.

Allows players to control the time of the game itself
At superior, introduces a new way to play master cards that are put into play (can't think of any abuse right now).

Messages.Author: Mael
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> Could you explain why you find it gives " far too much defense for a single card ".
>
> I mean, if your predator has already taken 4 actions, but need more to do you something, it's likely a swarm deck or an Una deck. Anyway, stopping him one turn doesn't seem abusive.
>
Well, not all of a players actions are going to be against the same target. For example, a lot of decks with light multi-acting will want to bloat or go backwards for part of their turn before taking action forwards. Some decks will want to take tool-up actions before going forwards (especially imbued). Some will have a mandatory hunt taking up 1 of their 4 actions for this turn.
A lot of cards include untapping the vampire as part of the effect of the card.
This card doesn't care if the actions are successful, so as part of a wall strategy you can easily limit what other defense you need.
You can also use it crosstable to deny your prey his oust turn in a much easier way than Eagle's Sight can do.
And as well as all that, as you say, it completely stops swarm decks for a turn. For a single free card that is already too powerful a result even if it didn't significantly affect other decks.

And when we say "for a turn", in terms of a real game, that's likely to be most turns, because if you are playing this card there's no reason to limit yourself to not playing 6 or more copies. You would very rarely have any difficulty cycling excess copies of it.

Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
I agree with the view that  should be a press, only usable to either end, or continue combat. One should take care to make outferiors superior to existing cards' inferior abilities. (Wait... what?  ) No, but seriously, a free press either way is a bit too much for thaumaturgy, which doesn't have unrestricted presses even on . Either make the minion burn a blood, or restrict the effect.

I, for one, can't see the problem in the  version. It honestly doesn't seem that over powered. Four actions is bleedin' plenty already. I can't see many decks being hosed by a couple of turns with "only" four actions. To be honest, I can't see many decks even attempting more than four on a regular basis. On top of that you'll need to be untapped to use the card, and so on. I think it's fairly balanced!

To be sure, it MIGHT cost a blood to use - the whole card, that is. I just can't think why that would be warranted. Especially if  effect only works for locations. I agree that unrestricted un-suddenable masters during your minion phase might be a bit over the top. Villeins on stolen vampires, pentexes, giant's bloods - you get the idea... The idea's fine, though, and I would be happy to see it either affecting only locations or non-trifle masters.

Or only trifles?!

Then again, the most effective masters are already trifles to begin with.

It's an interesting, and thematically fun card, which is by no means over powered in my opinion. Just be careful with the outferiors. I think Flames of Netherworld was glancing the edge already.

I'd love to playtest this one too. Are there .pdf print files already?
